prompt: Write docs.css for doc.html (it is in the working directory): Swedish product documentation that is mostly read on phones. The page uses system-ui at 1rem. Headings and body text contain long compound words, and there is a settings table with values such as 2,5 GB and 1 500 kr. Make it read well from 320px to 400px wide. Do not edit doc.html. Save docs.css.
assertions: At a 320px viewport, the page has no horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth at most 320)
Body paragraphs in the article compute hyphens: auto
Inline code and pre do not hyphenate: they compute hyphens none or manual
At a 320px viewport, every value cell in the settings table renders on a single line, so no number is split from its unit
Body paragraphs are not justified (computed text-align is start or left)
At a 320px viewport, the h1 does not overflow its own box (its scrollWidth is no larger than its clientWidth)
